review_notes: Environment grouping uses declared container.environment; service groups use stable service reference IDs, with service name used only for display/sort.

Schema cards preserve exact owner, schema/database/container IDs and generations, declared environment, assignment revision, and provisional/reference-only labeling. UI does not render host, port, transport, or server UUID values.

Each paged assignment is rendered under every returned service reference; the server-reported servicesTruncated flag adds an explicit omitted-coverage warning. Empty service lists retain a distinct no-declared-service group.

The existing project/token keyed component and request sequence invalidation protect navigation/logout; existing browser cases exercise delayed response, project switch, transfer, and revoked grant clearing. No writer endpoint was added in the reviewed UI/test diff.
Read existing browser log only: all 3 schema-reference browser tests passed (0 skipped, 0 failed); no tests were rerun under the read-only review assignment.
limitation: This is a UI-scope review; it does not certify API implementation or overall npm check.
